scientific_integrity: Constructive proof uses non-intersecting branch loci and Riemann–Roch. Finite computer checks are corroborative, not a proof of infinitely many cases. No external audit or validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Existence and exact base-field gonality for all odd finite fields, but no statement for even characteristic, no uniqueness/classification or point-count optimality. Complete supporting 2020 text not independently inspected. Unindexed mathematical literature might overlap.
title: Explicit genus-four tetragonal curves over every odd finite field
